form.addressPlaceholder: e.g. 10 rue de la Pomme 31000 Toulouse
form.roomsHint: T1 = 1 room, T2 = 2 rooms, etc. (as on property listings).
form.landAreaHintHouse: Optional. Cadastral plot or garden in m². Leave 0 or empty if there is no outdoor land or garden — the model runs without a garden uplift.
form.landAreaHintApartment: Private garden or land share in m². Use 0 if no garden — a value > 0 applies the garden uplift (+20%).
form.parkingHint: Number of parking spaces or garages (0 to 5).
form.amenitiesHintHouse: Indicative uplifts (house): pool ≈ +18%. Land plot size is built into the model (no separate “garden” checkbox). Price remains capped at the top of the MAPE range.
form.amenitiesHintApartment: Indicative uplifts (apartment): balcony/terrace ≈ +9%, garden (land area / garden > 0) ≈ +20%, shared condo pool ≈ +6.5%. Large low-demand tower ≈ −10%. Price remains within the MAPE range.
form.conditionHint: Rate each item from 1 (to redo) to 5 (excellent). Score 3 = market-average finish → 0%. Weighted average (kitchen, bathroom and technical posts weigh more). Indicative impact ≈ −15% to +8%, clamped inside the MAPE range. Unrated items are ignored.
form.floorElevatorHint: The adjustment depends on building height and the unit level (relative position), plus elevator presence. Clamped inside the MAPE range.
form.buildingStoreys: Number of floors in the building
form.floorElevatorExample: Example: 30-storey tower, apartment on the 9th → 30 and 9. The 9th of 30 is treated as a mid floor (not a top-floor premium).
form.unpopularTowerHint: Indicative discount ≈ −10% (liquidity, image, often high charges). Clamped inside the MAPE range.
form.editHint: Update the property details below, then click “Estimate price”.

result.ownershipToggleTitle: Would you like to enter ownership costs?

result.maintenanceTitle: Do you want to anticipate property maintenance?

result.ownershipTotalsHint: Charges (with optional uplift) + property tax + maintenance.
result.savingsChargesWithExceptional: Includes +{pct}% exceptional. Editable in Ownership costs.
result.savingsMaintenanceNote: Includes {pct}% maintenance of value. Editable in Ownership costs.
result.investmentToggleTitle: Would you like to simulate a rental investment?
result.investmentToggleHint: Rental yield, simplified tax, and cash flow.
result.investmentHint: Indicative simulation if you buy this property to rent it out (unfurnished). Metrics use rent × occupancy rate.
result.investmentRentNote: Default: 0.35% of the property price per month (full rent, before vacancy).
result.investmentTaxRegimeMicroHint: 30% flat allowance on rent. No itemized deduction of charges or interest.
result.investmentTaxRegimeReelHint: Deducts charges, property tax, maintenance, and first-year loan interest.
result.investmentMicroCeilingWarning: Micro-foncier usually applies up to {ceiling} gross rent / year. Switch to réel if you exceed this ceiling.
result.investmentOwnershipNote: Enable ownership costs to refine net yield and the réel regime.
result.investmentLoanNote: With no mortgage enabled: no deductible interest; cash flow = rent − ownership costs.
result.investmentNetNetYieldHint: Net yield after rental income tax.
result.investmentAnnualTaxHint: Of which income tax {income} + social contributions {social}.
result.investmentCashOnCashHint: Annual after-tax cash flow ÷ down payment.
result.investmentCashOnCashHintWorks: Annual after-tax cash flow ÷ (down payment + cash works).
result.investmentCashOnCashHintCash: Annual after-tax cash flow ÷ acquisition cost.
result.investmentDisclaimer: Simplified unfurnished rental tax (excludes furnished LMNP, deficit carryforward, deductible CSG). Excludes landlord insurance and management fees. Indicative only.
result.savingsToggleTitle: Would you like to compare with investing?
result.savingsToggleHint: What your capital and monthly savings could earn if, instead of buying, you rented your home.
result.savingsHint: Indicative comparison: you rent your home and invest your down payment plus net monthly savings.
result.savingsHintCash: Indicative comparison (cash purchase): you rent your home and invest the purchase budget plus net monthly savings.
result.savingsInitialNote: Equal to the mortgage down payment.
result.savingsInitialNoteWorks: Mortgage down payment + works (paid in cash).
result.savingsInitialNoteCash: Equal to the total purchase cost (cash purchase).
result.savingsInitialNoteCashWorks: Equal to the total project budget (cash purchase).
result.savingsMonthlyNoteCash: No mortgage: max(0, ownership costs − rent).
result.savingsInflationHint: Final capital deflated at {inflation}% inflation per year.
result.savingsInsight: Over {years} years at {rate}%, interest makes up about {share}% of the nominal final capital.
result.savingsRatesNote: Indicative benchmarks: Livret A / LDDS ~1.5% net; LEP ~2.5% net (means-tested). Simulation excludes tax.
result.verdictToggleTitle: Would you like to see whether buying or renting is better?
result.verdictToggleHint: A simple net-worth comparison at the end of the simulation horizon.
result.verdictHint: Indicative net-worth comparison at the end of the mortgage term, adding any monthly surplus if rent would have cost more than buying.
result.verdictHintCash: Indicative net-worth comparison over 10 years (cash purchase), adding unpaid rent (no mortgage payment).
result.verdictRentUsed: Reference rent used in this conclusion: {rent} / month (editable in Investing).
result.verdictBuyBreakdown: of which property equity {property} + surplus vs rent {rentSaved}
result.verdictBuyHint: Equity = future value − remaining loan. Surplus = max(0, rent − mortgage − ownership costs) × 12 × years. If the mortgage exceeds rent, surplus is zero.
result.verdictRentHint: Final capital from the savings simulator (nominal).
result.verdictPreferBuy: Over {years} years, buying is more favorable by about {gap}.
result.verdictPreferRent: Over {years} years, renting and investing is more favorable by about {gap}.
result.verdictDisclaimer: Indicative only; excludes tax, transaction costs, vacancy and unforeseen expenses. This is not financial advice.

about.title: About
about.intro: Hawk Prix Immo provides an indicative, non-binding estimate based on open data and a statistical model.
about.modelBody: The estimate uses an XGBoost model trained on DVF+ sales (Cerema), enriched with ADEME energy performance (DPE) data. Inputs include living area, outbuildings (cellars and parking spaces or garages), location, energy class, and year built.
about.amenitiesBody: These factors are not in the DVF+ model. When provided, an indicative uplift or discount is applied to the predicted price, then the result is always clamped inside the MAPE range (low and high) — it never leaves that uncertainty band.
about.amenitiesApartment: Apartment — amenities: balcony / terrace ≈ +9%, garden ≈ +20%, shared condo pool ≈ +6.5%. Large tower / low-demand residence ≈ −10% (liquidity, image, charges).
about.amenitiesHouse: House — amenities: garden ≈ +11.5%, pool ≈ +18%. Balcony / terrace is not applied (often already priced into the garden).
about.amenitiesFloor: Apartment — floor: enter the building’s number of floors and the unit floor (0 = ground). The adjustment uses relative position (e.g. 9/30 ≈ mid = 0% reference), not just the absolute floor number. Elevator: uplift/discount by level. Clamped inside the MAPE range.
about.amenitiesCondition: General condition: rate kitchen, bathroom, floors, paint/walls, electrics/plumbing, windows and heating (1 = to redo, 5 = excellent). Score 3 is market-average finish (0%). A weighted average yields an indicative adjustment of about −15% to +8%, clamped inside the MAPE range. Unrated items are ignored.
about.metricsIntro: Metrics measured on a chronological hold-out set (most recent sales, not used for training).
about.metricsR2Hint: Share of price variation explained by the model. A higher percentage means the model better explains observed prices.
about.metricsMaeHint: Mean absolute error in euros: average gap between predicted and actual prices on the test set.
about.metricsMapeHint: Mean absolute percentage error. It is also used to build the indicative range around the estimated price.
about.metricsNote: These figures describe average past error on a test set, not a guarantee for any single estimate.
about.geocodeBody: Your address is geocoded via the French national address base (Géoplateforme BAN). The match score reflects how closely your input matches the address used for the estimate.
about.agencyFeesDisclaimer: The main price shown excludes agency fees. DVF sale values only include agency fees when they are paid by the seller.
about.agencyFeesBuyerShareOutro: , agency fees are paid by the buyer in approximately 90% of cases.
about.faiBody: The price including agency fees (FAI) adds agency fees to the net price: either an adjustable percentage (4% by default) or a fixed amount in euros. The fee amount is the difference between the FAI price and the net price.
